standard.summary: SDXL 路线的 Block 级学习率差异化设置：分别对 UNet 的 down blocks / mid block / up blocks 设置独立的学习率权重，实现细粒度控制。
standard.effect: down_lr_weight 控制编码器（下采样）块的 LR 倍率；mid_lr_weight 控制瓶颈块；up_lr_weight 控制解码器（上采样）块。
standard.whenToUse: SDXL LoRA 时需要对不同层级差异化训练时使用。例如只训练解码器（up）可实现更精细的局部特征学习。
standard.avoidWhen: 不了解 UNet 各层功能时保持默认（所有层等权），差异化设置需要对模型行为有深入理解。

standard_en.summary: Block-level learning-rate differentiation on the SDXL route: independent learning-rate weights for the UNet's down blocks / mid block / up blocks, for fine-grained control.
standard_en.effect: down_lr_weight controls the LR multiplier of the encoder (downsampling) blocks; mid_lr_weight controls the bottleneck block; up_lr_weight controls the decoder (upsampling) blocks.
standard_en.whenToUse: For an SDXL LoRA when you need to train the different levels differently. Training only the decoder (up), for instance, gives finer local-feature learning.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Keep the default (every level weighted equally) if you do not know what each UNet level does; differentiated settings need a deep understanding of model behaviour.

advanced.principle: SDXL UNet 分三段：input_blocks（down，下采样，捕捉低级特征）/ middle_block（mid，瓶颈，高级语义）/ output_blocks（up，上采样，精细化和重建）。差异化 LR 权重等价于更粗粒度的 block weight 控制。smart_rank 根据各层梯度自动调整参与训练的 rank 数量。
advanced.tradeoffs: up_lr 过高 → 解码器训练过度，结果可能失去整体一致性；down_lr 过高 → 特征提取过度，可能影响其他 LoRA 兼容性。

advanced_en.principle: The SDXL UNet has three segments: input_blocks (down, capturing low-level features) / middle_block (mid, bottleneck, high-level semantics) / output_blocks (up, refinement and reconstruction). Differentiated LR weights amount to coarser-grained block-weight control. smart_rank automatically adjusts how many ranks participate in training per layer based on gradients.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: up_lr too high → over-trained decoder, results may lose global coherence; down_lr too high → over-extracted features, possibly hurting compatibility with other LoRAs.
